Pure substances and mixtures: Pure substances have a fixed composition; mixtures do not. Mixtures are homogeneous or heterogeneous.
Solutions, suspensions and colloids: Solutions, colloids and suspensions differ in particle size, settling and light scattering.
Concentration of solutions: Concentration is solute mass relative to the solution. Saturated solutions hold the maximum solute.
Methods of separation: Separation methods depend on the physical properties of components, such as solubility, boiling point and magnetism.
